face.text: Set your Mana Crystals to 0. Set the Cost of cards in your hand and deck to (1).
face.flavorText: "Is my deck any good?" "I mean, if the stars align."

face.name: 符文宝珠
face.text: 造成 2点伤害。发现一张法术牌。
face.flavorText: 最危险的冬幕节饰品。

face.name: Runed Orb
face.text: Deal 2 damage. Discover a spell.
face.flavorText: The most dangerous Winter Veil ornament.

face.name: 星界裂隙
face.text: 随机将两张随从牌置入你的 手牌。
face.flavorText: 让我们来看看一号裂隙的后面藏着什么！

face.name: Astral Rift
face.text: Add 2 random minions to your hand.
face.flavorText: Let's see what's behind rift number one!

face.name: 露娜的口袋银河
face.text: 使你牌库中所有随从牌的法力值消耗变为（1）点。
face.flavorText: 在露娜的导师发明了口袋黑洞之后，露娜成了天文系的新主任。

face.name: Luna's Pocket Galaxy
face.text: Change the Cost of minions in your deck to (1).
face.flavorText: Luna became head of the astronomy department when her boss invented the Pocket Black Hole.

face.name: 迸射流星
face.text: 对一个随从及其相邻的随从造成 1点伤害。
face.flavorText: 追星族请勿靠近。

face.name: Shooting Star
face.text: Deal 1 damage to a minion and the minions next to it.
face.flavorText: Literally starstruck.

face.name: 咒术洪流
face.text: 使你牌库中所有法术牌的法力值消耗减少（1）点。
face.flavorText: “参加活动享受法术减价，一切尽在咒术洪流之下。”

face.name: Incanter's Flow
face.text: Reduce the Cost of spells in your deck by (1).
face.flavorText: "Gettin' them discounts in bulk amounts, spells can come, and spells can go, castin' costs drop with my sweet, sweet flow."

face.name: 虚空之风传送门
face.text: 奥秘：在你的对手施放一个法术后，随机召唤一个法力值消耗为（4）的随从。
face.flavorText: 凭虚御风，不知其所止。

face.name: Netherwind Portal
face.text: Secret: After your opponent casts a spell, summon a random 4-Cost minion.
face.flavorText: More aromatic than a regular portal.

face.name: 唤醒
face.text: 用随机法师法术牌填满你的手牌。这些牌为临时牌。
face.flavorText: 一切有为法，如露亦如电。

face.name: Evocation
face.text: Fill your hand with random Mage spells. They are Temporary.
face.flavorText: You too could be the winner of the national spelling spree!

face.name: 能量之泉
face.text: 发现一张法师随从牌。如果你的牌库中没有随从牌，改为保留全部三张牌。
face.flavorText: 来自晶歌森林的天然好水。

face.name: Font of Power
face.text: Discover a Mage minion. If your deck has no minions, keep all 3 instead.
face.flavorText: It's Comic Sans.

face.name: 变形药水
face.text: 奥秘：在你的对手使用一张随从牌后，将其变形成为1/1的绵羊。
face.flavorText: 现已推出新产品：香蕉牛奶风味。

face.name: Potion of Polymorph
face.text: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, transform it into a 1/1 Sheep.
face.flavorText: Tastes like Baaaaananas.

face.name: 强能奥术飞弹
face.text: 随机对敌人发射三枚飞弹，每枚飞弹造成 3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 天呐，我还以为奥术飞弹已经够强了呢！

face.name: Greater Arcane Missiles
face.text: Shoot three missiles at random enemies that deal 3 damage each.
face.flavorText: Wow, and I thought Arcane Missiles was great!

face.name: 新月视界
face.text: 抽两张牌，抽到的随从牌法力值消耗减少（2）点。
face.flavorText: 其实…月亮上没什么好看的。

face.name: Lunar Visions
face.text: Draw 2 cards. Minions drawn cost (2) less.
face.flavorText: The true mystery of lunar visions is how there is nothing to watch when there are so many channels.

face.name: 月火术
face.text: 造成 1点伤害。
face.flavorText: “把月火术拖到每一个技能栏位上。”——《如何成为一名德鲁伊》，第五章，第三节

face.name: Moonfire
face.text: Deal 1 damage.
face.flavorText: "Cast Moonfire, and never stop." - How to Be a Druid, Chapter 5, Section 3

face.name: 变形术
face.text: 使一个随从变形成为1/1的绵羊。
face.flavorText: 你能想象一个嗜血的兽人发出咩咩的叫声吗？

face.name: Polymorph
face.text: Transform a minion into a 1/1 Sheep.
face.flavorText: There was going to be a pun in this flavor text, but it just came out baa-d.

face.name: 奥术智慧
face.text: 抽两张牌。
face.flavorText: 使用这张牌能让你变得更聪明。面对现实吧：变聪明些对我们大家来说都是好事。

face.name: Arcane Intellect
face.text: Draw 2 cards.
face.flavorText: Playing this card makes you SMARTER. And let's face it: we could all stand to be a little smarter.

face.name: 魔爆术
face.text: 对所有敌方随从造成 1点伤害。
face.flavorText: 魔爆术曾是让法师们区别于艾泽拉斯其他职业的技能之一。

face.name: Arcane Explosion
face.text: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions.
face.flavorText: This spell is much better than Arcane Implosion.

face.name: 咒术师的召唤
face.text: 双生法术 消灭一个随从。召唤两个法力值消耗相同的随从来替换它。
face.flavorText: 不要回答！不要回答！不要回答！

face.name: Conjurer's Calling
face.text: Twinspell Destroy a minion. Summon 2 minions of the same Cost to replace it.
face.flavorText: If only you’d let it go to voicemail…

face.name: 创世之力
face.text: 发现一张法力值消耗为（6）的随从牌。召唤两个它的 复制。
face.flavorText: 通常用于晚会表演，真的。

face.name: Power of Creation
face.text: Discover a 6-Cost minion. Summon two copies of it.
face.flavorText: Mostly used for party tricks, to be honest.

face.name: 魔术戏法
face.text: 发现一张法力值消耗小于或等于（3）点的法术牌。
face.flavorText: 我发明了一个深奥复杂的魔术，可惜这里地方太小，施展不出来！

face.name: Magic Trick
face.text: Discover a spell that costs (3) or less.
face.flavorText: The world is not ready for an illusion of this depth and intricacy!

face.name: 月光指引
face.text: 发现你牌库中一张牌的复制。如果你在本回合中使用这张复制，则抽取本体。
face.flavorText: 古夫总要等到半夜2点之后才能做出最佳决定。

face.name: Moonlit Guidance
face.text: Discover a copy of a card in your deck. If you play it this turn, draw the original.
face.flavorText: Guff always makes the best decisions after 2 AM.

face.name: 奥术溢爆
face.text: 对一个敌方随从造成 8点伤害。召唤一滩残渣，属性值等同于超过目标生命值的伤害。
face.flavorText: 在这艘船上，如果随从不能保持完整形体，就只能被扔到海里。变成浮点型随从。

face.name: Arcane Overflow
face.text: Deal 8 damage to an enemy minion. Summon a Remnant with stats equal to the excess damage.
face.flavorText: On this ship, when you can’t use an int, learn how to float.

face.name: 磷光射击
face.text: 造成 1点伤害，随机召唤一个法力值消耗与伤害量相同的随从。
face.flavorText: 但愿结果不会太糟。

face.name: Shimmer Shot
face.text: Deal 1 damage. Summon a random minion of that Cost.
face.flavorText: I hope I don't jinx the outcome.

face.name: 月蚀
face.text: 对一个随从造成 3点伤害。在本回合中，你施放的下一个法术的法力值消耗减少（2）点。
face.flavorText: 当艾泽拉斯运行到太阳和月亮之间时发生的现象。

face.name: Lunar Eclipse
face.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Your next spell this turn costs (2) less.
face.flavorText: When the Azeroth is between the Sun and the Moon.

face.name: 奥术吐息
face.text: 对一个随从造成 2点伤害。如果你的手牌中有龙牌，便发现一张法术牌。
face.flavorText: 食用奥术饼干的众多副作用之一。

face.name: Arcane Breath
face.text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. If you're holding a Dragon, Discover a spell.
face.flavorText: One of many side effects from eating mana cookies.

face.name: 奥术射击
face.text: 造成 2点伤害。
face.flavorText: 法师们用奥术强化箭矢，然后出售给猎人；后来猎人们自己学会了足够的魔法之后便能够自给自足。不少法师因此失业，给暴风城的经济带来不小的冲击。

face.name: Arcane Shot
face.text: Deal 2 damage.
face.flavorText: Magi conjured arcane arrows to sell to hunters, until hunters learned just enough magic to do it themselves. The resulting loss of jobs sent Stormwind into a minor recession.

face.name: 加大音量
face.text: 抽三张法术牌。压轴：从中发现一张复制。
face.flavorText: 加大音量还要消耗法力值？我以为在菜单里设置一下就好了！

face.name: Volume Up
face.text: Draw 3 spells. Finale: Discover a copy of one.
face.flavorText: You have to pay Mana to do that!? I thought it was just in the settings menu!

face.name: 灯光表演
face.text: 向敌人发射 道可以造成 2点伤害的灯光。你此后的灯光表演多发射一道。
face.flavorText: 搞艺术要时刻记得四个字，和光同尘。和是和平，同是协同，尘表示谦卑。光嘛，是激光！！

face.name: Lightshow
face.text: Shoot beams at enemies that each deal 2 damage. Your future Lightshows shoot one more beam.
face.flavorText: Always remember P.L.U.R.: Peace, Laser-beams, Unity, Respect.

face.name: 倒带
face.text: 发现你在本局对战中施放过的其他法术的一张复制。
face.flavorText: 如果没找到想要的法术，不如试试倒带重来。

face.name: Rewind
face.text: Discover a copy of another spell you've cast this game.
face.flavorText: If you don't find the spell you want, just cast this one more time and see if you get lucky.

face.name: 星火术
face.text: 造成 5点伤害。抽一张牌。
face.flavorText: 平衡对德鲁伊来说很重要。这张卡牌现在就很平衡了。

face.name: Starfire
face.text: Deal 5 damage. Draw a card.
face.flavorText: Balance is important to druids. This card is perfectly balanced.

face.name: 智慧秘典
face.text: 随机将一张法师法术牌置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 秘术的合订本就是秘典。

face.name: Tome of Intellect
face.text: Add a random Mage spell to your hand.
face.flavorText: Just a compilation of napkins of intellect.

face.name: 奥术飞弹
face.text: 造成 3点伤害，随机分配到所有敌人身上。
face.flavorText: 既然你想要做一个超级厉害的法师，就必须得把奥术飞弹控制得好一些。

face.name: Arcane Missiles
face.text: Deal 3 damage randomly split among all enemies.
face.flavorText: You'd think you'd be able to control your missiles a little better since you're a powerful mage and all.

face.name: 法术反制
face.text: 奥秘：当你的对手施放一个法术时，反制该法术。
face.flavorText: 一个会法术反制的法师和一个不会法术反制的法师之间有什么区别？那个不会的法师被炎爆术炸了一脸。

face.name: Counterspell
face.text: Secret: When your opponent casts a spell, Counter it.
face.flavorText: What's the difference between a mage playing with Counterspell and a mage who isn't? The mage who isn't is getting Pyroblasted in the face.

face.name: 镜像实体
face.text: 奥秘：在你的对手使用一张随从牌后，召唤一个该随从的复制。
face.flavorText: “你先上。”——“巨兽”克鲁什格尔对他的宠物野猪说道。

face.name: Mirror Entity
face.text: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, summon a copy of it.
face.flavorText: "You go first." - Krush'gor the Behemoth, to his pet boar.

face.name: 复制
face.text: 奥秘：当一个友方随从死亡时，将两张该随从的复制置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 您的本次卡牌复制行为不会导致账号被封停！

face.name: Duplicate
face.text: Secret: When a friendly minion dies, put 2 copies of it into your hand.
face.flavorText: The one time when duping cards won't get your account banned!

face.name: 袖珍次元
face.text: 发现一张法术牌。重复此效果，直到你再次见到选项中见过的牌。
face.flavorText: 一般来说，每次都能见到3张牌，而且其中没有过载牌。

face.name: Pocket Dimension
face.text: Discover a spell. Repeat until you see one for the second time.
face.flavorText: On average, this gets you around 3 cards. And none of them have Overload.

face.name: 星云
face.text: 发现并召唤两个法力值消耗为（8）的随从，并使其具有 嘲讽和扰魔。
face.flavorText: 原来你是我最想留住的星云~

face.name: Nebula
face.text: Discover two 8-Cost minions to summon with Taunt and Elusive.
face.flavorText: Do-re-mi-fa-so-ne-bu-la!

face.name: 星域相变射线
face.text: 抉择：随机对两个敌方随从造成 2点伤害；或者使一个敌方随从休眠2回合。
face.flavorText: 好吧妈妈，这次确实是逆反期的线相。

face.name: Astral Phaser
face.text: Choose One - Deal 2 damage to two random enemy minions; or Make one Dormant for 2 turns.
face.flavorText: Ok, Mom, in this ONE instance it IS a phase.

face.name: 阿肯尼特的启示
face.text: 抽一张牌。如果该牌是法术牌，则其法力值消耗 减少（1）点。
face.flavorText: 如果该牌是阿肯尼特，则收获启示。

face.name: Arkonite Revelation
face.text: Draw a card. If it's a spell, it costs (1) less.
face.flavorText: And if it's a rkonite, revel in it.

face.name: 究极边境
face.text: 发现一张来自过去的法力值消耗为（10）的随从牌，将其法力值消耗变为（1）点。

face.name: Final Frontier
face.text: Discover a 10-Cost minion from the past. Set its Cost to (1).

face.name: 宇宙浑象
face.text: 召唤三个2/3并具有嘲讽的元素。如果你的面板已满，使你的随从获得+1/+1。
face.flavorText: 你问哪个是浑象？图里的全都是。

face.name: Cosmic Phenomenon
face.text: Summon three 2/3 Elementals with Taunt. If your board is full, give your minions +1/+1.
face.flavorText: Which one you ask? Uhh, all of them.

face.name: 求救信号
face.text: 随机召唤两个 法力值消耗为（2）的随从。复原2个 法力水晶。
face.flavorText: 救命！救命！我的对手出牌了！

face.name: Distress Signal
face.text: Summon two random 2-Cost minions. Refresh 2 Mana Crystals.
face.flavorText: HELP! HEEELP! MY OPPONENT PLAYED CARDS!

face.name: 不稳定的传送门
face.text: 随机将一张随从牌置入你的手牌。该牌的法力值消耗减少（3）点。
face.flavorText: 艾泽拉斯的普通住民根本不知道让一座传送门稳定下来需要花费多少人力物力。我们每年要花费30%的GDP用于传送门维护。

face.name: Unstable Portal
face.text: Add a random minion to your hand. It costs (3) less.
face.flavorText: The denizens of Azeroth have no idea how much work goes into stabilizing portals. We spend like 30% of GDP on portal upkeep.

face.name: 麦迪文的残影
face.text: 将每个友方随从的各一张复制置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 麦迪文的残影徘徊于卡拉赞之中，这位昔日强大的守护者运用他的力量在下象棋和玩炉石传说时，不停地作弊。

face.name: Echo of Medivh
face.text: Put a copy of each friendly minion into your hand.
face.flavorText: Medivh's echo haunts Karazhan, eternally cheating at chess and Hearthstone.

face.name: 星辰能量
face.text: 随机对一个敌方随从造成 5点伤害。重复此效果，每次伤害减少1点。
face.flavorText: 多名追星观众被星倒追。

face.name: Star Power
face.text: Deal 5 damage to a random enemy minion. Repeat this with 1 less damage.
face.flavorText: Five of the spectators were star-struck.

face.name: 变形卷轴
face.text: 如果这张牌在你的手牌中，每个回合都会变成一张随机法师法术牌。
face.flavorText: 等到下回合，就会变成特别厉害的法术了！

face.name: Shifting Scroll
face.text: Each turn this is in your hand, transform it into a random Mage spell.
face.flavorText: Next turn, this is going to be AMAZING.

face.name: 惊奇套牌
face.text: 将五张惊奇卡牌洗入你的牌库。抽到时随机施放一个 法术。
face.flavorText: “挑一张卡吧，哪张都行。等等！不！别动那张！”——之前一个主人的遗言

face.name: Deck of Wonders
face.text: Shuffle 5 Scrolls into your deck. When drawn, cast a random spell.
face.flavorText: "Pick a card, any card. Wait! No! Not that one!" - Last words of previous owner

face.name: 玩具故障
face.text: 造成 3点伤害，随机分配到所有敌方随从身上。如果你的牌库中没有随从牌，再造成 3点。
face.flavorText: 报错：这张牌功能完好，没有故障。

face.name: Malfunction
face.text: Deal 3 damage split among all enemy minions. If your deck has no minions, deal 3 more.
face.flavorText: Bug Report: This card works perfectly.

face.name: 星辰坠落
face.text: 抉择：对一个随从造成 5点伤害；或者对所有敌方随从造成 2点伤害。
face.flavorText: 天塌下来了吗？是的。一点一点塌下来了。

face.name: Starfall
face.text: Choose One - Deal 5 damage to a minion; or 2 damage to all enemy minions.
face.flavorText: Is the sky falling? Yes. Yes it is.

face.name: 撕裂现实
face.text: 随机将2张来自过去的法师法术牌置入你的手牌，其法力值消耗减少（2）点。
face.flavorText: 有一次，我开出了一张黑色的花，一张会笑的壶，还有一张初版龙希尔闪卡。

face.name: Tear Reality
face.text: Add 2 random Mage spells from the past to your hand. They cost (2) less.
face.flavorText: One time it gave me a black flower, a smiling pot, and a foil first edition Dracthyr.

face.name: 秘法宝典
face.text: 随机获取3张法师法术牌。
face.flavorText: 秘法宝典？说不定里面有制作魔法点心的食谱……

face.name: Cabalist's Tome
face.text: Get 3 random Mage spells.
face.flavorText: What's in there? I bet it's cookie recipes!

face.name: 奥术防御者
face.text: 召唤两个5/6并具有嘲讽和扰魔的魔像。
face.flavorText: 注：防御范围不包括奥术战吼

face.name: Arcane Defenders
face.text: Summon two 5/6 Golems with Taunt and Elusive.
face.flavorText: *Arcane batteries not included*

face.name: 咒术之箭
face.text: 对一个随从造成 2点伤害。法力渴求（6）：抽取相同数量的牌。
face.flavorText: 这种发光的箭头，我们一般叫它“光标”。

face.name: Conjured Arrow
face.text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. Manathirst (6): Draw that many cards.
face.flavorText: We just call them "cursors".

face.name: 奥术箭袋
face.text: 从你的牌库中发现一张法术牌。如果选中的是奥术法术牌，使其获得法术伤害+1。
face.flavorText: 巫妖王：“袋！袋！袋！” 我：“好的。”

face.name: Arcane Quiver
face.text: Discover a spell from your deck. If it's Arcane, give it Spell Damage +1.
face.flavorText: "Quiver in fear!" - The Lich King "Ok." - Me

face.name: 弹溅射击
face.text: 随机对三个敌人造成 1点伤害。
face.flavorText: 简单几何学？很难的啦。

face.name: Ricochet Shot
face.text: Deal 1 damage to three random enemies.
face.flavorText: Simple geometry? Actually, I find it's quite complex.

face.name: 永歌传送门
face.text: 召唤 1只4/4并具有突袭的山猫（受法术伤害加成影响）。
face.flavorText: 回想一下，他们准备了那么多山猫，确实下了不少功夫。

face.name: Eversong Portal
face.text: Summon 1 4/4 (Lynx, Lynxes) with Rush (improved by Spell Damage).
face.flavorText: In retrospect, it's pretty impressive that they had the Lynxes just ready to go.

face.name: 奥术箭
face.text: 造成 2点伤害。法力渴求（8）：改为造成 3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 你等着，等到我有8点法力值的时候！

face.name: Arcane Bolt
face.text: Deal 2 damage. Manathirst (8): Deal 3 damage instead.
face.flavorText: Just you wait until I have 8 mana!

face.name: 衰变飞弹
face.text: 随机向敌方随从发射三枚飞弹，使其变形成为法力值消耗减少（1）点的随从。
face.flavorText: 校内法术对决赛总是以满地的小精灵收场。

face.name: Devolving Missiles
face.text: Shoot three missiles at random enemy minions that transform them into ones that cost (1) less.
face.flavorText: Most intermural spell-dueling contests end with a field of wisps.

face.name: 始生研习
face.text: 发现一张法术伤害随从牌。你的下一张法术伤害随从牌法力值消耗减少（1）点。
face.flavorText: 被世人遗忘的秘典，由内而外魔法充盈。神秘作者倾力打造，作者的名字叫……四十尘。

face.name: Primordial Studies
face.text: Discover a Spell Damage minion. Your next one costs (1) less.
face.flavorText: A long forgotten tome whose very essence seeps of magic. 40 dust, used.

face.name: 幻觉药水
face.text: 将你的所有随从的1/1的复制置入你的手牌，并使其法力值消耗变为（1）点。
face.flavorText: 悲剧的是，目前还没有能消除这些幻觉怪脸的药剂。

face.name: Potion of Illusion
face.text: Add 1/1 copies of your minions to your hand. They cost (1).
face.flavorText: Unfortunately, there's no potion that can make you unsee all the faces in that bottle.

face.name: 考前刷夜
face.text: 抽 1张牌（受法术伤害加成影响）。
face.flavorText: 教材上的奥术字体能赋予你近乎无穷的威力与能量！但它不能让你保持清醒，提神还得靠咖啡。

face.name: Cram Session
face.text: Draw 1 (card, cards) (improved by Spell Damage).
face.flavorText: The font of the arcane gives nearly limitless access to power and energy! But it can't keep you awake, for that we still use coffee.

face.name: 月光射线
face.text: 对一个敌人造成 1点伤害两次。
face.flavorText: 大分裂之后，月亮的光芒在辛艾萨莉的废墟中消散，可它的威力依然如故。

face.name: Moonbeam
face.text: Deal 1 damage to an enemy, twice.
face.flavorText: The light of the moon may have disappeared from Zin-Azshari after the Sundering, but not its power.

face.name: 变形术：水母
face.text: 将一个随从变形成为一只4/1并具有法术伤害+2的水母。
face.flavorText: 伊妮因为使用了自原性凝胶变形器而被取消了侏儒厨艺大赛的参赛资格，但她仍不会抛弃任何一项新发明。

face.name: Polymorph: Jellyfish
face.text: Transform a minion into a 4/1 Jellyfish with Spell Damage +2.
face.flavorText: While Ini’s first use of the Spontaneous Gelatin Transmalgamizer may have gotten her banned from the Gnomish Cooking Convention, she’s never one to throw away a new invention.

face.name: 星空投影球
face.text: 再次施放你在本局对战中施放过的法术，每种法力值消耗各随机一个。（尽可能以敌人为目标）
face.flavorText: 仔细观察这枚球体，你能看见宇宙的扩展，包括空间和时间。哦，其实只是影像而已。

face.name: The Galactic Projection Orb
face.text: Recast a random spell of each Cost you've cast this game (targets enemies if possible).
face.flavorText: Look closely in the ball and you'll see the expansion of space and time itself. Or their projections, anyway.

face.name: 闪光试剂瓶
face.text: 造成 2点伤害。在本回合中，你的下一张牌减少与伤害量相同的法力值消耗。
face.flavorText: 水瓶仍待提高。

face.name: Sparkling Phial
face.text: Deal 2 damage. Your next card this turn costs that much less.
face.flavorText: Lemme pull up your phial.

face.name: 无底玩具箱
face.text: 从你的牌库中发现一张牌。如果你拥有法术伤害，复制发现的牌。
face.flavorText: 没错，放在玩具箱里就对了。

face.name: Bottomless Toy Chest
face.text: Discover a card from your deck. If you have Spell Damage, copy it.
face.flavorText: That's right, it goes in the toy chest.

face.name: 星空祈愿
face.text: 使你手牌，牌库和战场上的所有随从获得+2/+3。
face.flavorText: “你想许个什么愿望呢？”“我想提高我的攻击力和生命值，一丁点就可以！”“……哦？你不想多加一点吗，比方说，加个一百万？”

face.name: Wish Upon a Star
face.text: Give +2/+3 to all minions in your hand, deck, and battlefield.
face.flavorText: "What are you going to wish for?" "I wish I had just a liiiiiiiittle more Attack and Health!" "...Really? You don't want, like, a million more?"

face.name: 裂魂残像
face.text: 奥秘：当你的随从受到攻击时，召唤一个该随从的复制。
face.flavorText: 被人打得灵魂出窍的感觉……还挺迷幻的。

face.name: Splitting Image
face.text: Secret: When one of your minions is attacked, summon a copy of it.
face.flavorText: Sometimes you get punched so hard they see double.

face.name: 艾萨拉的恩赐
face.text: 抽一张牌。如果你在本牌在你手中时使用过纳迦牌，再抽一张。
face.flavorText: 理发师：你想要什么发型？ 纳迦：你想要奥术的力量吗？ 理发师：好了别说了。

face.name: Gifts of Azshara
face.text: Draw a card. If you played a Naga while holding this, do it again.
face.flavorText: Barber: What do you want? Naga: You ever have a thirst for arcane power? Barber: Say no more.

face.name: 诺甘农的智慧
face.text: 抽两张牌。在本局对战中，你每施放过一个不同派系的法术，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。
face.flavorText: 现在我们所需的还剩下诺甘农的力量与勇气。

face.name: Wisdom of Norgannon
face.text: Draw 2 cards. Costs (1) less for each different spell school you've cast this game.
face.flavorText: Now all we need is the power and courage of Norgannon.

face.name: 星辰排列
face.text: 将你手牌中的随从牌变形成为法力值消耗增加（3）点的随从牌。（保留其原始法力值消耗。）
face.flavorText: 是砂糖，不，沙漠方尖碑！

face.name: The Stars Align
face.text: Transform minions in your hand into ones that cost (3) more. (They keep their original Cost.)
face.flavorText: Sweet, three Desert Obelisks!

face.name: 远古谜团
face.text: 从你的牌库中抽一张奥秘牌。其法力值消耗为（0）点。
face.flavorText: 我不是说这是外星人干的，这根本就是外星人干的！

face.name: Ancient Mysteries
face.text: Draw a Secret from your deck. It costs (0).
face.flavorText: I'm not saying it was aliens, but it was TOTALLY aliens!

face.name: 法术共鸣
face.text: 奥秘：当你的对手施放一个法术时，将该法术的一张复制置入你的手牌，其法力值消耗变为（0）点。
face.flavorText: 好厉害的法术，我也要！

face.name: Mana Bind
face.text: Secret: When your opponent casts a spell, add a copy to your hand that costs (0).
face.flavorText: Nice spell. YOINK!

face.name: 远古雕文
face.text: 发现一张法术牌，使其法力值消耗减少（2）点。
face.flavorText: 雕文上的符号翻译过来就是“抱歉”。

face.name: Primordial Glyph
face.text: Discover a spell. Reduce its Cost by (2).
face.flavorText: It's the Ancient Tol'vir symbol for "Whoops!"

face.name: 星夜露宿
face.text: 选择三次：抽两张牌；获得5点护甲值；或者复原三个法力水晶。
face.flavorText: 三次？！接下来还有什么，四次吗？！

face.name: Sleep Under the Stars
face.text: Choose Thrice - Draw 2 cards; Gain 5 Armor; Refresh 3 Mana Crystals.
face.flavorText: THRICE?! What's next, FOURTHST?!

face.name: 秘法宝典
face.text: 随机获取3张法师法术牌。
face.flavorText: 秘法宝典？说不定里面有制作魔法点心的食谱……

face.name: Cabalist's Tome
face.text: Get 3 random Mage spells.
face.flavorText: What's in there? I bet it's cookie recipes!

face.name: 观星
face.text: 抽一张不同的奥术法术牌。如果你在本回合中使用这张抽到的牌，则会施放两次。
face.flavorText: 看到天上的光点了吗？那就是“星星”。哦，你说那个，那个不是星星，那个叫“飞机”。

face.name: Stargazing
face.text: Draw a different Arcane spell. If you play it this turn, it casts twice.
face.flavorText: See those dots up there? Those are called "stars." Except for that one. That's called an "airplane."

face.name: 星体射击
face.text: 造成 3点伤害。你的下一个法术拥有法术伤害+2。
face.flavorText: 这一箭确实是星体射的。

face.name: Celestial Shot
face.text: Deal 3 damage. Your next spell has Spell Damage +2.
face.flavorText: He sure did.

face.name: 制造法力饼干
face.text: 将一张可以复原两个法力水晶的饼干置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 她挂机就是为了这个。

face.name: Conjure Mana Biscuit
face.text: Add a Biscuit to your hand that refreshes 2 Mana Crystals.
face.flavorText: So THIS is why she was AFK.
